name: PostGIS for PostgreSQL 18
summary: PostGIS, spatial types, rasters and functions for PostgreSQL on GEOS, PROJ and GDAL, built with zig; once installed, PostgreSQL's server finds it
license: GPL-2.0-or-later AND LGPL-2.1-or-later AND MIT AND blessing AND Zlib AND libtiff AND IJG AND libpng-2.0 AND Apache-2.0 AND Qhull

modules.name: postgis
build: sed -i -e '/^[[:space:]]*$(MAKE) @RT_LOADER@$/d' -e '/^[[:space:]]*$(MAKE) -C loader install$/d' raster/Makefile.in && ! grep -q 'RT_LOADER@\|-C loader install' raster/Makefile.in

sed -i 's/^Datum \([A-Za-z_0-9]*\)(PG_FUNCTION_ARGS);/PGDLLEXPORT Datum \1(PG_FUNCTION_ARGS);/' postgis/*.c topology/*.c raster/rt_pg/*.c && grep -q '^PGDLLEXPORT Datum ST_SymDifference(PG_FUNCTION_ARGS);$' postgis/lwgeom_geos.c

g=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(command -v gdalinfo)")") && sdk=$(dirname "$(pg_config --bindir)") && PKG_CONFIG_PATH="$g/lib/pkgconfig;$sdk/lib/pkgconfig" CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fmacro-prefix-map=$sdk=pgsdk -fmacro-prefix-map=$g=gdalsdk" sh ./configure --build=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --prefix=B:/prefix --with-pgconfig="$(command -v pg_config)" --with-gdalconfig="$g/bin/gdal-config" --with-geosconfig="$g/bin/geos-config" --with-jsondir="$g" --with-libiconv="$g" --with-raster --without-protobuf --without-address-standardizer --without-interrupt-tests --disable-nls --disable-extension-upgrades-install lt_cv_deplibs_check_method=pass_all PERL="$(command -v perl)" > configure.log 2>&1 || { tail -40 configure.log; tail -80 config.log; exit 1; }
grep -A40 'PostGIS is now configured' configure.log || true

g=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(command -v gdalinfo)")") && sdk=$(dirname "$(pg_config --bindir)") && make -j"$(nproc)" "SQLPP=cc -E -x c -traditional-cpp -P -w -Upixel -Ubool" "CXX=c++ -std=c++11 -O2 -s" "COPT=-fmacro-prefix-map=$sdk=pgsdk -fmacro-prefix-map=$g=gdalsdk" > make.log 2>&1 || { grep -n 'error:' make.log | head -20; tail -40 make.log; exit 1; }

p=$(echo "$PREFIX" | tr '\\' /) && make install "INSTALL=install -c" "SQLPP=cc -E -x c -traditional-cpp -P -w -Upixel -Ubool" "CXX=c++ -std=c++11 -O2 -s" pkglibdir="$p/lib" datadir="$p/share" includedir_server="$p/include/server" bindir=B:/src/postgis/out-bin > install.log 2>&1 || { tail -40 install.log; exit 1; }
cd "$PREFIX/share/extension" && for f in *.sql; do if [ -L "$f" ]; then t=$(readlink "$f") && rm "$f" && cp "$t" "$f"; fi; done && [ -z "$(find . -type l)" ]

g=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(command -v gdalinfo)")") && mkdir -p "$PREFIX/bin" && cp "$g"/bin/libgdal-*.dll "$PREFIX/bin/" && cp -r "$g/share/gdal" "$g/share/proj" "$PREFIX/share/" && cp -r "$g/licenses" "$PREFIX/"

printf '%s\r\n' '@echo off' 'echo This image is PostGIS 3.6.4, with GEOS 3.15.0, PROJ 9.9.0, GDAL 3.13.3 and json-c 0.19, for PostgreSQL 18.' 'echo Installed, PostgreSQL'"'"'s server finds it: CREATE EXTENSION postgis; in a database, and postgis_raster, postgis_topology, postgis_tiger_geocoder.' 'echo PROJ finds its proj.db through PROJ_DATA, and GDAL its data through GDAL_DATA, which this image sets; GDAL'"'"'s DLL is on its PATH.' 'echo zigsaw run --noextension=^<its id^> leaves it out.' > "$PREFIX/about.bat"
